description:
Greetings from Qualitas Technologies/Datasensor India Pvt.
 WEBSITE: https://qualitastech.com/ /
Datasensor: https://datasensor.in/ 

We are pleased to announce an exciting internship opportunity for the position of Full-Stack AI & Machine Vision Application Engineer Intern at Bangalore (RR Nagar). 
 This internship offers hands-on exposure to the complete engineering stack, covering Industrial Hardware, AI Software, Computer Vision, Machine Vision, and Industrial Automation.
 
 Job Description Full-Stack AI & Machine Vision Engineer Intern 
 Position: Full-Stack AI & Machine Vision Engineer Intern
 Location: Bangalore, RR Nagar
 Openings : 4
 Experience : Freshers
 Duration: 6 Months
 Stipend: Up to 15,000 per month (from the second month onwards, based on experience and performance)
 Training Period: First Month – Unpaid Training
 Career Opportunity: Potential full-time employment based on performance. 
 Role Overview 
This is a Full-Stack Engineering Role – From Industrial Hardware to AI Software, offering hands-on experience across the complete machine vision technology stack.
 You will build, integrate, install, and deploy AI-powered machine vision systems t hat inspect real products on actual factory production floors.
 The role covers both hardware and software engineering, including industrial cameras, lenses, lighting systems, sensors, hardware integration, Python programming, OpenCV, Computer Vision, and AI/ML-based inspection applications.
 You will be involved in the complete project lifecycle, from hardware setup and AI software configuration to system integration, customer-site installation, testing, and production commissioning.
 It is a hands-on, end-to-end engineering opportunity where you will work across Hardware, Software, AI, and Industrial Automation. 
 Who Can Apply? Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech / M.Tech graduates from: Mechatronics Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Electronics Engineering Electronics & Communication Engineering Freshers are welcome! Key Responsibilities 1. AI Software & Application Development Assist in developing, configuring, and deploying AI-powered machine vision applications. Work with image processing, computer vision, and AI-based inspection software. Support software installation, configuration, testing, and debugging. Gain exposure to Python programming, OpenCV, and AI/ML-based applications. Assist in integrating software applications with industrial cameras, sensors, and automation systems. Perform application testing and validation to ensure accuracy and reliability. 2. Hardware Integration & Machine Vision Assist in integrating industrial cameras, lenses, lighting systems, sensors, and other hardware components. Support the setup and configuration of machine vision inspection systems. Understand hardware-software communication and connectivity. Assist in testing and optimizing vision-based inspection solutions. 3. Customer-Site Installation & Implementation Visit customer locations to install and deploy AI software and machine vision systems. Perform on-site hardware installation, software configuration, and system integration. Support commissioning and testing of solutions in customer production environments. Coordinate with customers to understand technical requirements and provide implementation support. Troubleshoot software, hardware, connectivity, and integration-related issues at customer sites. 4. Technical Support & Documentation Provide on-site and remote technical support to customers. Prepare technical documentation, installation guides, user manuals, and project reports. Assist in customer training and demonstrate the operation of deployed solutions. Work closely with engineering teams to resolve technical challenges. Technical Skills & Requirements Basic understanding of programming concepts, preferably Python or C/C++. Familiarity with image processing, OpenCV, or Computer Vision is an added advantage. Basic knowledge of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning concepts. Understanding of hardware components, sensors, cameras, and electronic systems. Interest in software installation, configuration, debugging, and system integration. Basic knowledge of networking, operating systems, and hardware-software communication is beneficial. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities. Willingness to travel to customer locations for installation, integration, and technical support. Excellent learning attitude, adaptability, and willingness to work in a fast-paced technical environment. What We Are Looking For We are looking for candidates who are equally interested in exploring AI Software and Industrial Hardware . Candidates should be comfortable working in both office and customer-site environments, handling real-world technical challenges, and supporting end-to-end implementation of AI-powered machine vision solutions. Note: This position involves customer-site visits and hands-on installation, commissioning, and integration activities. Candidates should be comfortable with travelling to customer locations as required.

EDI delivers secure, high-quality, and accessible data assets alongside reliable, scalable platforms that help Visas business teams and partners develop innovative products and services. 
 Our areas of focus span Business Intelligence and Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Platform as a Service. With a portfolio of over 60 data products and platforms supporting internal lines of business and external clients, EDI provides the technology and processes to manage Visas data assets and deliver valuable information and services at scale. 
 The Software Engineer would be a part of a high-performance global team responsible for the delivery of features in the Enterprise Data Intelligence (EDI) program. 
 We are seeking an Associate Software Engineer to join the Enterprise Data Intelligence (EDI) Engineering team. You will contribute to the development of next-generation AI solutions that transform Business Intelligence through Generative AI, Machine Learning, Conversational AI, and Developer Productivity tools. 
 This role is ideal for engineers who are passionate about AI technologies and eager to work on enterprise-scale solutions that directly impact customer experience and operational efficiency. 
 Every engineer in this team will work in close collaboration with Generative AI tools as development companions, leveraging Visas extensive portfolio of AI models, tools, and experimentation platforms. 
 As a key member of the delivery execution team, candidates would need to create scalable designs, write maintainable code, reusable components/services/utilities, and test cases. 
 Responsibilities: 
 Work independently on defined problems and features Apply established architectural patterns with good technical judgment Take ownership of code quality, testing, and production reliability Partner with GenAI agents for code generation, refactoring, and automated testing. Experiment in Visas AI sandbox, where multiple GenAI models and frameworks are available for employee-driven innovation. Apply Generative AI models to API integration challenges, anomaly detection, and intelligent automation. Collaborates actively within a crossfunctional team Translate functional requirements into clean, efficient, and maintainable code. Write highquality, readable, and testable code aligned with defined engineering standards. Develop and maintain automated unit and component tests. Identify and address defects, performance issues, and reliability gaps in owned areas. Participate in production releases and operational readiness activities. Work closely with Product Managers, DevOps, and peer engineers. 
 Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. Qualifications Basic Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline, OR 3+ years of relevant work experience. 
 Preferred Qualification: 
 12 years of hands-on software engineering experience building, delivering, and supporting enterprise-grade Java/J2EE applications, preferably using Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, and modern front-end frameworks such as Angular or React. Hands-on experience with AI-assisted software delivery, including effective use of generative AI coding assistants and developer productivity tools such as Claude Code CLI, GitHub Copilot, Cline, or similar tools for prompt engineering, AI-supported code review, test generation, documentation, and productivity workflows. Working knowledge of applied AI concepts relevant to software engineering, such as large language models, embeddings, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, model limitations, data privacy, and responsible AI practices. Strong foundation in software engineering principles, clean code practices, object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and scalable application architecture. title: ServiceNow Lead Developer
description:
Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here: At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-plus-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, advisory, and consulting groups as well as our enabling services functions. That’s why we continually invest in innovation, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry. Job Description: What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe 
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes. In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development. Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence. Crowe is seeking an experienced ServiceNow Implementation Lead to design, develop, and implement scalable solutions on the ServiceNow platform. This hands-on role will focus on developing enterprise applications, automating business processes, integrating external systems, and delivering high-quality solutions that enable clients to maximize the value of the Now Platform. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with consulting skills and enjoys solving complex business challenges through innovative platform development. Responsibilities Design, develop, configure, and maintain scalable solutions on the ServiceNow platform using platform development best practices. Develop custom applications, workflows, integrations, and reusable components leveraging JavaScript, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Script Includes, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, and other platform capabilities. Configure and extend ServiceNow applications, including but not limited to ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HRSD, CSM, SPM, IRM, and custom applications based on client requirements. Develop and maintain REST and SOAP integrations with internal and third-party enterprise systems. Design and optimize Service Catalog offerings, workflows, record producers, and self-service experiences using Employee Center, Service Portal, and UI Builder. Build and support Workspace experiences, Next Experience components, and mobile capabilities. Design and maintain data models, CMDB structures, and Common Service Data Model (CSDM) relationships where applicable. Implement platform security using ACLs, application scoping, roles, and security best practices. Collaborate with solution architects and technical leads to develop scalable, maintainable, and upgrade-friendly platform solutions. Translate business requirements into technical designs and implementation plans using Agile methodologies. Perform code reviews, troubleshoot complex platform issues, optimize performance, and support testing and deployment activities. Utilize source control, update set management, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps best practices to support application lifecycle management. Lead technical discussions, client workshops, and design sessions while providing guidance on ServiceNow platform capabilities and best practices. Produce clear technical documentation, development standards, and implementation artifacts. Mentor junior developers and contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes and coding standards. Basic Qualifications 5+ years of professional software development or platform engineering experience, hands-on ServiceNow development experience. Experience designing, developing, and implementing enterprise solutions on the ServiceNow platform. Strong understanding of ServiceNow architecture, platform capabilities, and application development best practices. Experience working within Agile delivery methodologies. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and consulting skills. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams. Bachelor’s degree Certification in ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) Preferred Qualifications Strong JavaScript development skills and proficiency with ServiceNow scripting APIs and development frameworks. Experience with Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, App Engine Studio, Service Portal, UI Builder, and Workspace development. Certifications in any of the following: ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) One or more ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certifications (ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HRSD, CSM, SPM, IRM, or other product areas) ITIL Foundation Certification Experience building and supporting REST/SOAP integrations and API-based solutions. Knowledge of platform security, application scoping, ACLs, and governance best practices. Experience with CMDB, CSDM, Discovery, or Service Mapping is preferred. Familiarity with source control, Git, update sets, CI/CD, and DevOps practices. Understanding of ITIL concepts and enterprise service management processes. Experience developing across multiple ServiceNow product areas is highly desirable. Ability to lead technical solution design while mentoring other developers. What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe: Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes. In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development. Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence. We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times. Our Benefits: 
At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!

 How You Can Grow: 
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!

 More about Crowe: Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world. Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge. We are committed to a merit-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

title: Frontend Architect
description:
About Ginesys Ginesys is India's leading retail technology platform, powering 1,200+ customers and 50,000+ users through the unified GinesysOne suite - ERP, Cloud POS (Zwing), Order Management (Browntape), GST Compliance (EaseMyGST), and BI (InsightX). We are evolving from a System of Records to a System of Intelligence through Ginesys.AI. 
 Role Summary The Frontend Architect is the single accountable owner of enterprise frontend architecture across all products. This person defines the reusable foundation layer, and frontend governance model that every product team builds on - enabling consistent, scalable, and intuitive experiences across ERP, POS, OMS, WMS, Reporting, and future modules. This is a matrix leadership role. The Fronend Architect does not own product-specific design decisions or engineering implementation - those stay with Product Managers and Engineering respectively. Instead, this role sets the standards, patterns, and governance those decisions must work within, and partners closely with Product Management, Engineering, and Customer Success to apply them. This is a hands-on architecture and design leadership role. The person doesn't just define standards on paper - they build reusable component libraries, foundation screens, and research-backed patterns that product teams consume directly. 
 What This Role Owns - Enterprise Frontend architecture: the long-term development architecture strategy across all products. - UI Foundation Layer: reusable screens and patterns (auth, navigation, dashboards, tables, forms, filters, notifications, empty / loading / error states) that every product consumes. - Design capability building: mentoring frontend developers and leads and guiding front-end engineers on SOLID and DRY principles. 
 What This Role Does Not Own - Product roadmap or feature prioritization: owned by Product Managers. - Product-specific UX decisions: co-owned with Product Managers within the enterprise design system - this role sets the standards, Product Managers decide the product's specific workflows. - Engineering implementation and technology stack decisions: owned by Engineering Architects; this role ensures designs are aligned with and feasible on the chosen stack. - People management of designers embedded in product teams: reporting model to be confirmed with leadership. - Brand identity and marketing collateral: owned by Marketing/Brand, where such a function exists; this role ensures product UX stays brand-compliant. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Enterprise Frontend Architecture - Define the long-term Frontend architecture strategy across all products and own the scalable enterprise design framework. - Establish standardized Frontend principles, reusable interaction models, navigation frameworks, and common user journeys for enterprise workflows. - Define information architecture standards and a scalable component taxonomy that enables rapid product development. Frontend Foundation Layer - Architect and standardize a reusable frontend foundation layer - authentication, navigation, search, dashboards, notifications, tables/data grids, forms, filters, pagination, reports, wizards, dialogs, and standard empty/loading/error/success states. - Ensure this foundation reduces implementation effort for every future product and module. Technology Alignment - Collaborate with Engineering Architects to ensure designs align with the technology stack and are technically scalable. - Partner with engineering teams through implementation to protect design intent. Matrix Collaboration And Leadership - Work across Product Management, Engineering, Customer Support, Customer Success, Sales, and Implementation teams - influencing without direct authority. - Mentor UI developers, guide front-end engineers, and conduct design workshops to build organizational design capability. Continuous Innovation - Track industry trends (AI-powered UX, conversational interfaces, design automation, micro frontends, cross-platform design) and recommend adoption where it strengthens the enterprise experience. Required Experience 14+ years in frontend development and architecture, including at least 5+ years leading enterprise frontend development. Experience architecting frontend across multiple products in an enterprise SaaS organization. Strong front-end technical fluency (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, React/Angular/Vue) to credibly partner with engineering. Experience running UI governance - design reviews, quality gates, and pattern library management. Experience operating in a matrix organization - influencing Product, Engineering, and Customer Success without direct authority. Bachelor's degree in Engineering, or a related discipline; Master's degree preferred. 
 Helpful Experience Retail domain experience - POS, ERP, Order Management, Warehouse Management, Omnichannel Retail, e-commerce, or Supply Chain. Experience with the specific design and front-end tooling in use (Figma, FigJam, Storybook, design tokens, micro-frontend architecture). Exposure to AI-enabled product experiences and conversational interfaces. Experience working with globally distributed product and engineering teams. 
 Benefits : We like to think that talent grows at Ginesys and stays at Ginesys. To ensure this, we provide our employees with the best working environment, the latest technology and continuous support. We go out of our way to retain the small business feeling with which we started and stimulate innovation and collaboration through teamwork and our non-hierarchical approach. We offer competitive salary, and other fantastic perks and benefits, such as: Ginesys Academy for holistic training and development Comprehensive health insurance coverage Excellent rewards and recognition policy Transparent compensation policy with no unnecessary deduction in CTC Annual company off-site and a variety of events, celebrations throughout the year Travelling opportunities between our offices across the country. Annual Ginesys walkathon & related sporting events. Quarterly Coffee with the CEO and more! 
 Here s our story; now tell us yours 
 Ginesys is India s best omni retail suite backed by Ginesys, the first integrated Retail specific ERP software for online retail, offline retail and distribution. It is the largest Indian company in the retail tech industry catering to both online and offline needs. 1200 + brands including (Manyavar, V-Mart, Skechers) are accelerating their businesses with Ginesys. With a team of 400+ employees, Ginesys One plans to revolutionize retail by being a single-stop cloud-based retail suite. We have a pan India presence with offices in major cities including Gurgaon, Kolkata, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Coimbatore & Goa and are expanding rapidly. We love the challenges of retail and are busy solving them to create a great retail tech suite. Ginesys core mission is to continue to build world-class internal service capabilities, in a bid to deliver outstanding external service value to customers. We are an ISO-certified and SOC compliant company having won myriad awards for our innovation and support. For further information, please visit our website http://ginesys.in

title: Technical Lead
description:
About Ginesys Ginesys is India's leading retail technology platform, powering 1,200+ customers and 50,000+ users through the unified GinesysOne suite - ERP, Cloud POS (Zwing), Order Management (Browntape), GST Compliance (EaseMyGST), and BI (InsightX). We are evolving from a System of Records to a System of Intelligence through Ginesys.AI. 
 About the role Ginesys Insights 2.0 is our next-generation, multi-tenant analytics and reporting platform for India's leading retail brands. It replaces a third-party BI engine for about 500 customers. It has a governed semantic layer, self-service workbooks, dashboards, scheduling and exports, built on Java/Spring Boot, Next.js and Google BigQuery on GCP. The product is moving from a fast-built foundation to a production release. We need a hands-on Technical Lead to own delivery end to end: architecture, release readiness, quality, cross-team dependencies and the engineering team. 
 What you'll own Delivery and planning - Own the plan from PRD to delivery: turn the PRD, the metrics catalogue (185 P0 metrics) and the UX task list into epics, stories, sprints and owners, and keep tracking in line with what has actually shipped. - Run sprint planning, estimation, risk and dependency registers, and status reporting to product and leadership. - Plan and run the customer migration waves from the legacy BI tool, including parity sign-off. - Close open scope decisions with Product, for example MVP AI Chat and the open decision registers. 
 Architecture and technical direction - Own the overall architecture across the Java/Spring Boot backend-for-frontend (BFF), the Node.js/Next.js/React frontend and PostgreSQL. - Work with Product and Data Engineering on how business metrics are defined and served, and make sure the engineering design supports them. - Strengthen security: centralise authentication and authorisation, prove tenant isolation, and harden row-level security, column-level security and masking. - Own the API contract (OpenAPI) between frontend and backend, including versioning. 
 Production readiness - Stand up staging and production environments on GCP with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform). That includes Cloud Run, Cloud SQL sizing and connection budgets, Secret Manager and IAM. - Set up monitoring, metrics and tracing, SLOs, alerting, incident management and rollback runbooks. - Set up release management: versioning, the dev-to-main release train, promotion gates and change control for database migrations. - Set up cost governance for cloud and query usage, including usage metering for billing. 
 Quality - Define and enforce quality gates: coverage thresholds and static analysis; end-to-end tests (Playwright); automated tenant-isolation tests; and metric reconciliation against control totals from the ERP source. - Set code-review standards and guardrails for AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) so speed doesn't cost correctness or security. 
 People and stakeholders - Lead and mentor a team of 4-6 engineers across backend and frontend, working with UX/design. Reduce key-person dependency through knowledge sharing and clear ownership. - Be the single technical point of contact for Product, the Ginesys One/G1 platform team (SSO, identity delegation), Security, Cloud/DevOps and Data Engineering (the BigQuery Gold pipeline). - Drive external blockers to closure: per-user BigQuery identity through Workforce Identity Federation, scheduler delegation, and SMTP and storage connectors. 
 Must have - 10+ years in software engineering, including 3+ years as Tech Lead or Engineering Lead shipping a multi-tenant B2B SaaS product to production. - Strong hands-on Java (17+, ideally 21) and Spring Boot 3: REST API design, JDBC/SQL with PostgreSQL, transactions, Flyway, JUnit and Testcontainers. Able to review and write production code. - Strong hands-on Node.js and TypeScript: server-side JavaScript, API routes and the backend-for- frontend (BFF) pattern, npm ecosystem and build tooling. - Strong hands-on React (hooks, component design, state management such as Zustand or Redux, data fetching with React Query) and Next.js (App Router, server components, route handlers, SSR). - Google Cloud: Cloud Run, Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL), IAM, Workload Identity Federation, Secret Manager, Artifact Registry. - Secure multi-tenant design: SSO (OAuth2/OIDC token exchange), session management, RBAC, audit trails, OWASP practices. - CI/CD with GitHub Actions, containers, and canary or blue-green deployments. - Proven delivery management: Agile/Scrum, estimation, risk management, stakeholder reporting, and managing dependencies on other teams. - Strong written communication. The project is heavily documented (PRDs, API contracts, blocker and incident logs). 
 Good to have - Google BigQuery or another cloud data warehouse: query cost control, dry runs, partitioning and clustering, performance tuning. - Cube.js or another semantic layer / metric store (dbt metrics, LookML). - Analytics and BI domain: star schemas, pivots and aggregations, non-additive measures and distinct counts, metrics spanning several fact tables, row- and column-level security on reports. - Experience replacing or migrating a BI or reporting tool (Exago, Qlik, Power BI, Looker, Tableau, Metabase). - Terraform; OpenTelemetry, Prometheus or Grafana, or Cloud Monitoring; SLO-based operations. - Retail or ERP domain knowledge: sales, inventory, stock movement, margin, GST, Indian number formats. - AG Grid Enterprise (server-side row model) or similar data-grid tooling. - Experience leading teams that use AI coding assistants, and setting review policies for AI-generated code. 
 What success looks like in 6 months - Staging and production running on infrastructure-as-code, with monitoring, alerting and a tested rollback. - The MVP (Sales, Inventory, Margin catalogue, dashboards, RBAC/RLS/CLS, scheduling) live with the first migration-wave customers. - Automated tenant-isolation and metric-reconciliation tests gating every release. - The backlog, trackers and code in sync, every item with an owner and a sprint. - No single point of failure for CI/CD or core modules.

description:
Job Description: We are looking for a hands-on, AI-enabled Full Stack Engineering Team Lead who can lead a team of 24 engineers while actively contributing to architecture, coding, reviews and production problem-solving. The candidate should have strong backend expertise in Node.js, MongoDB, MySQL and AWS , along with the ability to build modern AI-enabled applications and integrate AI capabilities into existing SaaS products. We are not looking for an AI/ML researcher . We are looking for a strong software engineer who understands how to use modern AI technologies, LLMs and AI development tools to build better products and make engineering teams significantly more productive. 
 Please note :- Depends on the Interview we would be able to give you the grade and position Experience Range: 8 - 12 years Educational Qualifications: BCA,B.Tech/B.E Job Responsibilities: Key Responsibilities 
 
 Full Stack Technical Leadership 
 
 Design and build scalable applications and backend services primarily using Node.js / TypeScript. 
 
 Remain hands-on with development, architecture, debugging and complex technical problem-solving. 
 
 Design scalable APIs, services, integrations and asynchronous processing workflows. 
 
 Own technical architecture and engineering quality for the team's product areas. 
 
 Conduct code and architecture reviews and establish strong engineering practices. 
 
 Take end-to-end ownership from design development testing deployment production stability. 
 
 AI-Enabled Product Engineering 
 
 Build and integrate AI-powered capabilities into existing and new Petpooja products. 
 
 Integrate applications with LLMs and AI platforms through APIs and SDKs. 
 
 Build practical AI workflows involving LLMs, RAG, tool/function calling, agents and structured AI outputs where appropriate. 
 
 Work with Product and AI teams to convert AI ideas and prototypes into production-ready, scalable product capabilities. 
 
 Understand key AI engineering considerations including context management, hallucination, evaluation, latency, security and cost. 
 
 Design appropriate fallback and validation mechanisms for AI-powered workflows. 
 
 Evaluate when AI is the right solution and when a deterministic software solution is better. 
 
 AI-Enabled Engineering 
 
 We expect the Team Lead to actively drive an AI-first engineering culture within the team. 
 
 Effectively use modern AI coding and development tools for coding, debugging, testing, documentation, and code understanding. 
 
 Use AI to accelerate code generation, refactoring, test-case generation, debugging and legacy-code understanding. 
 
 Help engineers adopt AI-assisted development practices while maintaining strong code-review and quality standards. 
 
 Identify repetitive engineering activities that can be automated using AI. 
 
 Experiment with AI agents and developer workflows that improve engineering productivity. 
 
 Establish the principle that AI accelerates engineering judgement rather than replacing it. 
 
 Database Data Engineering 
 
 Design and optimise applications using MongoDB and MySQL. 
 
 Have strong understanding of schema/data modelling, indexing, query optimisation and transactions. 
 
 Diagnose database and application performance bottlenecks. 
 
 Design caching strategies using Redis or similar technologies. 
 
 Make appropriate architectural decisions between relational, NoSQL, caching and other storage mechanisms. 
 
 Design data access patterns suitable for both traditional and AI-enabled application workloads. 
 
 AWS Scalable Architecture

Job Title: Senior Developer (C#, SQL Server, TypeScript ) 
 Location: Kochi (Hybrid) 
 Permanent - Full Time 
 
 
 About Us 
 Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,800+ employees and 70,000+ customers across 100+ countries and 46+ offices. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end-to-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the worlds largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen & Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass & Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North & South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa. 
 
 Cyncly offers over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end-to-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience. 
 
 Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specializing in technology. 
 Availability between 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM IST is required to support collaboration with our global teams. 
 About the Role 
 We are looking for a highly experienced, hands-on Senior Developer / Technical Architect with 10-15 years of software engineering experience to develop, enhance, and support our fenestration software platform. The role will focus on resolving complex product defects, delivering new features, improving product stability and performance, and modernizing existing components. The ideal candidate can quickly understand complex business workflows and troubleshoot issues end-to-end across frontend, backend, database, and integrations. 
 Key Position Responsibilities Include: Own complex bug fixes and feature development from analysis through production release. Perform root-cause analysis across UI, APIs, business logic, SQL Server, integrations, and background processes. Design and develop scalable solutions using Vite, TypeScript, .NET/C#, and MS SQL Server. Troubleshoot performance, concurrency, data integrity, integration, and high-volume processing issues. Work with Product, QA, Support, and domain experts to understand and resolve customer-impacting issues. Perform code reviews and provide technical guidance and mentorship to developers. Improve code quality, automated testing, diagnostics, maintainability, and overall product stability. Contribute to the technical modernization of a mature enterprise application while protecting existing customer workflows. 
 Required Experience and Qualifications: 10-15 years of software development experience in Senior Developer, Technical Lead, or Architect roles. TypeScript & Vite, C# / .NET / .NET Core, Microsoft SQL Server. REST APIs and system integrations. Strong understanding software architecture, design patterns, SOLID principles, scalability, and application performance. Expert troubleshooting skills across frontend, API, backend, database, integrations. Strong SQL expertise includes query optimization, transactions, concurrency, locking, and performance tuning. Experience supporting and enhancing large, mature, business-critical enterprise applications. Strong experience with unit/integration testing, CI/CD, source control, and code reviews. Ability to independently drive complex technical problems from root cause through resolution.
 Nice to Have: Experience in fenestration, window & door, manufacturing, or fabrication software domain. Understanding of product configuration, quoting, BOM generation, order processing, purchasing, supplier/dealer workflows, and manufacturing processes. Experience with CPQ, ERP, or complex rules-driven product configuration systems. Experience modernizing legacy enterprise applications and integrating modern web technologies with established platforms. 
 Working for Us 
 At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills - and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.
 
 Here, you ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth.
 
 We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone - from every background - to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.
 
 If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in - Come join us.

title: Senior Designer
description:
Senior Design System Designer (Design Operations) Updated Nov 2026 Who we are We are a huge, multi-faceted media organisation who provide services to global clients on a large scale, however the role we are recruiting for is to join our Global Data and Technology team - a technology-based team separated from the agency-led work we do for our clients. Within our Global Data and Technology team we are designing a purpose-built digital platform via many smaller teams, to help build products that facilitate the internal operations and daily activities of both our staff and the clients they serve. The role we are recruiting for - is to join our Design System team -, that enables our programme to build products at scale, to provide a consistent and harmonised user experience. We are scaling up this Design system team to advance our practice of both evolving the design system itself; as well as make it truly agent-ready and agent-agnostic for use by various teams that are on the frontier of design engineering building rapidly at pace, with confidence that experiences are consistent across the platform. We traditionally maintain libraries in Figma but are expanding the ways we advance our design documentation and React libraries to make the Design system easily consumable via different methods and Product design processes. We are a passionate, warm and respectful collective who collaborate closely with each other on a daily basis. We are fully remote, so do this through the magic of Microsoft Teams. 
 What were looking for As we develop our product workstreams at pace - having a robust design system at the core of our product solutions is critical to our success. We are therefore looking to hire a Senior Design System Designer to join our existing Design System team - to help with the creation, management and documentation of our design system and support the product designers who use it. 
 
 This person should see the world through components, be a Figma native, be passionate about the detail of both the visual style and construction of components. Their day-to-day tasks will often revolve around focusing on the details of how components are structured in Figma, token usage and consistency, props and variants, tending to bugs, and ultimately ensuring they work optimally for practitioners that need to use the system, to ensure it is one designers can use with ease. They will be keen to continually evolve our system, in the spirit of continuous improvement, by working on new components briefed by the Design Leadership team. The role is an opportunity for an experienced UI or design systems practitioner to deepen their expertise in large-scale platform design, component architecture and emerging AI-assisted design workflows, with accessibility front of mind. They will be comfortable researching, discussing and documenting the purpose of components and patterns, to integrate them into our established system, whilst cognisant of how changes can have downstream impact on other components. Communication both written and oral is a key aspect of this role; not only for the day-to-day communication between team members within the Design System team, but also the role they play in helping educate other design practitioners using the system, on how to use them. They will be hungry to move with the times and advance how AI will play a part in Design Operations and management of Design systems, and assist on how to make that a reality. They will have an affinity with both the design side and the code itself and be keen to keep design system drift to a minimum. 
 What you ll do The right candidate will be involved in a range of activities: Taking on requirements for new components: doing research and discovery on component best practice, discussing use cases with teams and eventually (if required) creating new components in Figma for re-use Create clear documentation for a design system, that is visually compelling and simple for teams to understand - so others know which components and patterns to use and when. Working with front end developers to ensure consistency between our designed and built components. Help to maintain an existing large figma library - rolling out updates as Figma releases new features, bug fixes and enhancements to existing components. Work closely and collaboratively with Design Leadership, Product Designers and PO s to ensure we re working towards a common goal and milestones are met. Support product designers in translating complex product requirements into established system patterns, identifying where new patterns may be required. Keeping their finger on the pulse on all things visual design - tools, accessibility, new patterns and design system trends from the outside world. What you ll need to apply It s important that candidates have evidence of work to show prior to interview. Essential Advanced Figma experience, particularly components, variables, libraries and responsive patterns. Experience contributing to or maintaining a mature design system. Strong systematic UI design thinking, demonstrated through reusable components and patterns rather than only bespoke product screens. Strong understanding of accessibility and inclusive component design. Experience documenting component behaviour, usage and rationale. Experience collaborating closely with front-end engineers. Clear communication and the ability to explain design-system decisions to designers and engineers. undefined Desirable Experience with design tokens and token workflows.Familiarity with React/component-based front-end development.Experience using AI within design-system or product-design workflows.Experience with design-system governance or operations.Responsive product-design experience.Illustration or visual asset creation.
